Notes: OP's stock weighting is VW with a cap on the max weight for a single stock being 10%.  We do EW for simplicity.
Detailed Definition: Advertising expenses (xad) divided by BrandCapital. Brand capital is computed by the perpetual inventory method. In the first year, brand capital is advertising expense divided by (.5 + .1). In subsequent years, we let brand capital depreciate with a rate of .5 and add current advertising expenses. Brand capital is scaled by total assets (at). Set to missing if advertising expense is missing.  Drop if 1st digit of sic = 4 or 6, and keep only Dec fiscal year ends.
